messages.无法确定当前主程序构建版本。: The current application build could not be determined.
messages.Fiji 安装包版本不符合模块指定依赖。: The Fiji package version does not match the module’s required dependency.
messages.修复共享 Fiji 必须使用模块已安装时的依赖版本。: Repairing shared Fiji requires the dependency version recorded for the installed module.
messages.共享 Fiji 缺失、损坏或版本不匹配；请完成更新或修复当前模块。: Shared Fiji is missing, damaged or has the wrong version. Complete the update or repair the current module.
messages.修复源的 Fiji 依赖与已安装模块记录不一致。: The repair source’s Fiji dependency differs from the installed module record.
messages.运行时会显示程序内部进程: Internal processing details appear here during analysis.
messages.此任务没有已保存的运行细节。: No run details were saved for this analysis.
messages.细胞核与胞体路线并行执行，各路线耗时不能相加。: Nucleus and cell-body processing run in parallel; their durations must not be added.
messages.模型加载与源图统计并行执行；准备阶段总耗时采用实际经过时间。: Model loading and source statistics overlap. Preparation time is the actual elapsed time.
messages.图像与模型准备：实际经过时间: Image and model preparation: elapsed time
messages.运行记录较长，此处仅显示部分内容。: This view shows part of the run record.
messages.按四类标记物选择实际源通道，缺失项选择“未包含”。导入图像后即可选择通道。: Assign an actual source channel to each marker category. Choose “Not included” for missing markers. Import an image to select channels.
messages.CPU 有效温度传感器的平均值。: Average of valid CPU temperature sensors.
messages.GPU 有效温度传感器的平均值。: Average of valid GPU temperature sensors.
messages.组数为驱动报告的 mGPU 分组；利用率为整个 GPU 的读数。: Groups are reported by the GPU driver; usage applies to the whole GPU.
messages.Fiji 审核与发布（含人工等待）: Fiji review and publication (includes manual waiting)
messages.批次耗时（同批窗口共享）: Batch time (shared by windows in this batch)
messages.测量通道参与 ROI 定义: Measurement channel used for ROI definition
messages.一次读取全部原始 Z 层并生成定位统计: Reading the source Z planes and computing localization statistics.
messages.读取原生统计；模型同时加载: Reading native statistics while the model loads.
messages.等待共享模型准备完成: Waiting for the shared model to finish loading.
messages.识别 DAPI 核与独立原生胞体，并恢复逐层证据: Detecting DAPI nuclei and independent cell bodies, then recovering their Z-plane evidence.
messages.处理局部 DAPI 特征与原生三维归属: Processing local DAPI features and native 3D assignments.
messages.测量每个原生核区域的 Support 与逐层证据: Measuring support-channel and Z-plane evidence for each native nucleus.
messages.原生候选与逐层证据已就绪，请复核并确认: Candidates and Z-plane evidence are ready for review and confirmation.
